svg.title: How Kera answers: from your message to the saved reply
svg.desc: Twelve numbered steps. Your message is turned into a prompt (1 and 2). The knowledge mode (3) decides whether passages are retrieved (4), whole documents are used or nothing is added, and passages are placed in the prompt (5). A loop then repeats every round: guardrails scan the call (6), the model answers or asks for tools (7), tools run (8) and the prompt is fitted to the window (9). When the model answers without tool calls, the answer is cited (10), the guardrails scan the reply (11) and it is saved and traced (12).

g.text: From the web app or the API
next round: the guard runs again
